title: Nutty Filipino Peanuts Hash
description: A savory, nutty hash featuring crumbled tofu, roasted peanuts, and aromatic cumin, perfect for a quick halal-friendly solo dinner.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic, sautéing until the onion turns translucent, about 3 minutes.
Throw in the diced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally to avoid sticking.
Add the sliced mushrooms and crumbled tofu; cook until the tofu lightly browns and the mushrooms soften, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the chopped red bell pepper, ground cumin, and tamari; cook for another 2 minutes until the peppers begin to soften.
Fold in the chopped roasted peanuts and season with salt and pepper; let everything heat through for 2 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Remove from heat and sprinkle the chopped cilantro over the hash.
Serve hot straight from the skillet, optionally with a side of steamed rice or a fresh cucumber salad.
If desired, garnish with additional peanuts or a squeeze of lime for extra zing.
Enjoy your nutty, gooey Filipino peanut hash as a satisfying solo dinner.
